title: Mamdani’s Ability to Persuade Trump Hits Limit in Wake of ICE Shooting
summary: After a federal agent shot an immigrant in New York City, inciting protests, some of Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s allies questioned his attitude toward the president and his own Police Department.
